name: The Salsa Speaker on the Pier
brief: A speaker on a Hudson pier keeps playing after its battery has been dead for an hour and a hundred dancers do not stop to ask, eye flowers opening in the grille cloth, sunset burning across the river behind them, color story: sunset flamingo pink and Hudson blue over ink black
